articles.author: Anusuya Lahiri
articles.headline: One AI Stock To Buy Right Now? This Fund Manager Picks Micron
articles.summary: Is the Micron rally over? Investors weigh a 2% premarket dip against bullish cash flow forecasts and high analyst price targets.
articles._summary: Nasdaq futures fell 0.21%, while S&P 500 futures slipped 0.04%. The decline appeared to reflect broader weakness in technology stocks and profit-taking after Micron’s strong rally over the past year. The softer futures market weighed on higher-beta chip stocks before the opening bell. Micron remains well above its longer-term trend levels, but investors have become more cautious following signs that the stock’s recent momentum has slowed.
articles._zh_headline: 现在应该购买一只人工智能股票吗？这位基金经理选择了美光科技
articles._zh_summary: 纳斯达克期货下跌 0.21%，标准普尔 500 指数期货下跌 0.04%。此次下跌似乎反映出科技股普遍疲软，以及美光科技去年强劲反弹后的获利回吐。开盘前，期货市场走软对贝塔值较高的芯片股造成压力。美光科技仍远高于其长期趋势水平，但在有迹象表明该股近期势头放缓后，投资者变得更加谨慎。

articles.author: Rishabh Mishra
articles.headline: Stock Market Today: S&P 500, Nasdaq 100 Futures Fall As Trump Says Iran Wants To Negotiate—AtaiBeckley, J B Hunt, AST SpaceMobile in Focus
articles.summary: U.S. stock futures declined on Thursday, as the Dow Jones, Nasdaq 100, and S&P 500 indices fell, following Wednesday's higher close.
articles._summary: U.S. stock futures declined on Thursday, as the Dow Jones, Nasdaq 100, and S&P 500 indices fell, following Wednesday’s higher close. President Donald Trump said Iran wants to negotiate even as U.S. forces launched a second wave of strikes against Iranian military targets. Meanwhile, the U.S. Treasury announced new sanctions targeting an international network accused of procuring weapons for Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps following attacks on commercial vessels in the Strait of Hormuz.
articles._zh_headline: 今日股市：特朗普表示伊朗希望进行谈判，标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克 100 指数期货下跌——AtaiBeckley、J B Hunt、AST SpaceMobile 成为焦点
articles._zh_summary: 美国股指期货周四下跌，道琼斯指数、纳斯达克 100 指数和标准普尔 500 指数继周三收盘走高后下跌。唐纳德·特朗普总统表示，即使美军对伊朗军事目标发动第二波袭击，伊朗仍希望进行谈判。与此同时，美国财政部宣布对一个国际网络实施新的制裁，该网络被指控在霍尔木兹海峡袭击商船后为伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队采购武器。

articles.author: Eva Mathew
articles.headline: Stock Market: Will S&P 500 Open Up or Down Today?
articles.summary: July 16, 2026: Polymarket traders turn cautious despite cooler inflation, easing Treasury yields and another day of gains for the S&P 500.
articles._summary: The S&P 500 climbed for a second straight session on Wednesday as fresh signs of easing inflation and upbeat corporate earnings supported equities. However, Polymarket traders are growing more cautious about Thursday’s open. The S&P 500 gained 0.38% to close at 7,572.40. However, the July 16 Polymarket contract implied just a 37% probability that the index would open higher on Thursday, with odds steadily declining throughout Wednesday’s trading.
articles._zh_headline: 股市：今天标普 500 指数会上涨还是下跌？
articles._zh_summary: 周三，标准普尔 500 指数连续第二个交易日上涨，因通胀放缓和企业盈利乐观的新迹象支撑了股市。然而，Polymarket 交易员对周四的开盘变得更加谨慎。标准普尔 500 指数上涨 0.38%，收于 7,572.40 点。然而，7 月 16 日的 Polymarket 合约暗示该指数周四开盘走高的可能性仅为 37%，而在整个周三的交易中，这一可能性稳步下降。

articles.author: Namrata Sen
articles.headline: Elizabeth Warren Grills Fed Chair Kevin Warsh Over Stanley Druckenmiller Ties: 'Who Gave You $100 Million?'
articles.summary: Sen. Elizabeth Warren questioned Fed Chair Kevin Warsh over an undisclosed $100 million divestment and ethics concerns.
articles._summary: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh was subjected to intense questioning by Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) regarding potential ethics violations. On Wednesday, his second day of monetary policy testimony on Capitol Hill, Warsh was grilled by Warren about a $100 million amount he was required to divest after becoming Fed chair, and which he refused to disclose, asking if anyone gave him that amount before he was sworn in.
articles._zh_headline: 伊丽莎白·沃伦 (Elizabeth Warren) 就斯坦利·德鲁肯米勒 (Stanley Druckenmiller) 关系问题质问美联储主席凯文·沃什 (Kevin Warsh)：“谁给了你 1 亿美元？”
articles._zh_summary: 美联储主席凯文·沃什（Kevin Warsh）受到参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦（马萨诸塞州民主党人）关于可能违反道德规范的强烈质疑。周三，也就是沃什在国会山作货币政策证词的第二天，沃什被沃伦质问，他在成为美联储主席后需要撤资 1 亿美元，但沃什拒绝透露这一数字，并询问是否有人在他宣誓就职之前给了他这笔钱。

articles.author: Ananya Gairola
articles.headline: Jim Cramer Says ASML Rally Reflects AI Market 'Mood' as Shay Boloor Calls ASML the 'Toll Road' of the AI Revolution
articles.summary: ASML's strong earnings drew bullish comments from Boloor, while Jim Cramer said the stock's rally reflects improving AI market sentiment.
articles._summary: ASML gained 2.23% to close at $1,815.27 on Wednesday after reporting better-than-expected second-quarter results and raising its 2026 outlook for the second time this year. The stock, however, slipped 2.26% to $1,774.23 in Thursday premarket trading, according to Benzinga Pro. Following the earnings report, Futurum Equities chief market strategist Shay Boloor argued that ASML sits at the center of the AI chip ecosystem.
articles._zh_headline: Jim Cramer 表示 ASML 集会反映了人工智能市场的“情绪”，Shay Boloor 称 ASML 是人工智能革命的“收费公路”
articles._zh_summary: ASML周三上涨2.23%，收于1,815.27美元，此前该公司公布了好于预期的第二季度业绩，并今年第二次上调了2026年的展望。然而，根据 Benzinga Pro 的数据，该股在周四盘前交易中下跌 2.26% 至 1,774.23 美元。财报发布后，Futurum Equities 首席市场策略师 Shay Boloor 认为 ASML 处于 AI 芯片生态系统的中心。

articles.author: Avi Kapoor
articles.headline: Dow Jumps 150 Points Following Producer Inflation Data: Investor Sentiment Improves, Fear & Greed Index In ‘Neutral’ Zone
articles.summary: U.S. stocks gain, led by Amazon and Alphabet. Apple hits record high. Aehr Test Systems and Morgan Stanley report strong earnings. PPI data cools inflation fears.
articles._summary: The CNN Money Fear and Greed index showed some improvement in the overall market sentiment, while the index remained in the “Neutral” zone on Wednesday. U.S. stocks settled higher on Wednesday, with the Dow Jones index gaining around 150 points during the session following the release of PPI data. On the economic data front, headline producer prices dropped 0.3% in June versus expectations for no change, with the annual rate cooling to 5.5% from 6.2%, while core PPI rose a smaller-than-expected 0.2%.
articles._zh_headline: 生产者通胀数据公布后，道琼斯指数上涨 150 点：投资者情绪改善，恐惧和贪婪指数处于“中性”区域
articles._zh_summary: CNN 货币恐惧与贪婪指数显示整体市场情绪有所改善，但周三该指数仍处于“中性”区域。美国股市周三收高，在 PPI 数据公布后，道琼斯指数盘中上涨约 150 点。经济数据方面，6 月份总体生产者价格下降 0.3%，而预期没有变化，年率从 6.2% 降至 5.5%，而核心 PPI 涨幅低于预期 0.2%。

articles.author: Namrata Sen
articles.headline: Marco Rubio Says President Lula 'Put His Ego Ahead of Making a Deal' as Trump Slaps Brazil With 25% Tariffs
articles.summary: Trump imposes 25% tariffs on most Brazilian imports under Section 301, with duties potentially rising to 37.5% next week.
articles._summary: The Trump Administration announced a 25% tariff on most Brazilian imports late Wednesday, effective July 22. Other points of contention comprise preferential tariffs for Mexico and India, weak intellectual property enforcement, and barriers in the ethanol market. United States Trade Representative (USTR) Jamieson Greer said year-long negotiations with Brazil failed to resolve the identified trade issues, but the U.S. remains willing to continue talks to achieve meaningful reforms.
articles._zh_headline: 马可·鲁比奥表示，特朗普对巴西征收 25% 关税，卢拉总统“以自我为先”
articles._zh_summary: 特朗普政府周三晚间宣布对大多数巴西进口产品征收 25% 的关税，自 7 月 22 日起生效。其他争论点包括对墨西哥和印度的优惠关税、知识产权执法薄弱以及乙醇市场的壁垒。美国贸易代表（USTR）贾米森·格里尔表示，与巴西长达一年的谈判未能解决已确定的贸易问题，但美国仍然愿意继续谈判以实现有意义的改革。

articles.author: Rishabh Mishra
articles.headline: Mira Murati Unveils Open-Weight AI Model as Alex Karp, Satya Nadella Warn Companies Are Giving Away Their IP
articles.summary: Mira Murati's new Inkling AI solves the enterprise IP crisis warned by Microsoft's Satya Nadella and Palantir's Alex Karp.
articles._summary: Her startup, Thinking Machines Lab , recently released “Inkling,” an open-weight AI model designed to let businesses customize AI without exposing their proprietary data. The launch of Inkling arrives exactly as major tech executives warn that relying on frontier AI labs is jeopardizing enterprise data and competitive advantages. Murati’s new release directly addresses these enterprise fears.
articles._zh_headline: 米拉·穆拉蒂 (Mira Murati) 推出开放权重人工智能模型，亚历克斯·卡普 (Alex Karp) 和萨蒂亚·纳德拉 (Satya Nadella) 警告公司正在放弃其知识产权
articles._zh_summary: 她的初创公司 Thinking Machines Lab 最近发布了“Inkling”，这是一种开放式人工智能模型，旨在让企业在不暴露其专有数据的情况下定制人工智能。 Inkling 的推出恰逢主要科技高管警告称，依赖前沿人工智能实验室正在危及企业数据和竞争优势。 Murati 的新版本直接解决了这些企业的担忧。

articles.author: Radhika Anilkumar Nadig
articles.headline: Apple Intelligence's China Win Sparks Rally in Alibaba, Baidu Shares in Hong Kong
articles.summary: Shares of Alibaba and Baidu rose in Hong Kong after China approved Apple's generative AI service, clearing the way for Apple Intelligence.
articles._summary: Hong Kong-listed Alibaba shares were up about 4.76% at 118.80 HKD ($15.16), while Baidu gained nearly 3.91% at 111.70 HKD ($14.25) at the time of writing. Alibaba’s Qwen large language model will power Apple Intelligence across Apple’s operating systems in China, while Baidu will support AI features on iPhones in the country, CNBC reported .
articles._zh_headline: Apple Intelligence 的中国胜利引发阿里巴巴和百度股价在香港的上涨
articles._zh_summary: 截至撰写本文时，香港上市的阿里巴巴股价上涨约 4.76%，至 118.80 港元（15.16 美元），而百度则上涨近 3.91%，至 111.70 港元（14.25 美元）。据 CNBC 报道，阿里巴巴的 Qwen 大语言模型将为 Apple Intelligence 在中国的苹果操作系统提供支持，而百度将支持中国 iPhone 上的人工智能功能。

articles.headline: Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh's testimony to Senate banking committee hits on economy, interest rates
articles.summary: As part of congressionally mandated Capitol Hill appearances for the central bank leader, Warsh spoke Tuesday to the House financial services committee.
articles._summary: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh testified Wednesday before the Senate banking committee, facing questions over the economy and how various factors might impact interest rates. As part of congressionally mandated Capitol Hill appearances for the central bank leader, Warsh spoke Tuesday to the House financial services committee. During his remarks, he reaffirmed the Fed's commitment to fighting inflation though he gave few clues about the direction of monetary policy. Legislators tried baiting Warsh into commenting on fiscal and political matters, but he largely avoided the topics, stressing the importance of the Fed staying focused on its assigned responsibilities.
articles._zh_headline: 美联储主席凯文·沃什向参议院银行委员会作证对经济和利率造成打击
articles._zh_summary: 美联储主席凯文·沃什周三在参议院银行委员会作证，面临有关经济以及各种因素如何影响利率的问题。作为国会授权央行行长出席国会山的一部分，沃什周二向众议院金融服务委员会发表讲话。在讲话中，他重申了美联储对抗通胀的承诺，尽管他没有透露有关货币政策方向的任何线索。立法者试图引诱沃什就财政和政治问题发表评论，但他基本上回避了这些话题，强调美联储专注于其指定职责的重要性。

articles.author: Parshwa Turakhiya
articles.headline: Are Crypto Prices Lying? Bitwise's Q2 Data Suggest the Bull Market Never Stopped
articles.summary: Q2 saw a 36% drop in crypto assets but a 23% gain in crypto equities. Top crypto apps earned $5.9B in revenue, while tokenized RWAs hit $33B.
articles._summary: Bitwise’s Head of Research Ryan Rasmussen says crypto asset prices tell only half the story from Q2, with equities, revenue, and real-world adoption all moving in the opposite direction from token prices. The gap between crypto assets and crypto equities was the defining story of the first half. Crypto assets dropped 36%, making them the worst-performing major asset class alongside gold, which fell 7%. Everything else finished green.
articles._zh_headline: 加密货币价格在撒谎吗？ Bitwise 第二季度数据表明牛市从未停止
articles._zh_summary: Bitwise 的研究主管 Ryan Rasmussen 表示，加密资产价格只说明了第二季度情况的一半，股票、收入和现实世界的采用率都与代币价格相反。加密资产和加密股票之间的差距是上半年的决定性故事。加密资产下跌 36%，与黄金一起成为表现最差的主要资产类别，黄金下跌 7%。其他一切都变成绿色。

articles.author: Piero Cingari
articles.headline: Wall Street Gave Up on PayPal, But the Stock Just Had Its Best Day Ever
articles.summary: PayPal shares jumped 17.2% on a reported $60.50-a-share bid from Stripe and Advent. Down 85% from 2021 highs, the discount is what drew buyers in.
articles._summary: A payments company that has lost more than 80% of its value in five years just posted the largest single-day gain of its eleven-year public life . PayPal Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: PYPL ) rose 17.19% on Wednesday, the biggest daily rally since the company’s 2015 spin-off. What Happened: Reuters reported that Stripe Inc. and Advent International Corp. submitted a joint proposal earlier this month at $60.50 a share, valuing PayPal at more than $53 billion.
articles._zh_headline: 华尔街放弃了 PayPal，但该股刚刚经历了有史以来最好的一天
articles._zh_summary: 一家在五年内市值损失超过 80% 的支付公司刚刚公布了其上市十一年以来最大的单日涨幅。 PayPal Holdings Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：PYPL）周三上涨 17.19%，这是该公司 2015 年分拆以来的最大单日涨幅。发生了什么：据路透社报道，Stripe Inc. 和 Advent International Corp. 本月早些时候提交了一份联合提案，每股价格为 60.50 美元，对 PayPal 的估值超过 530 亿美元。
